hero.motivationalText2: 🎯 Employment, career change, career advancement - One Step fully supports your first step in Japan.
hero.welcomeDescription: Welcome to One Step Corporation. We are a trusted partner providing professional job placement services, language education, and cross-cultural support for international talent in Japan. We connect talented individuals from around the world with Japanese companies and fully support global career success.
hero.aboutDescription: We are the 'bridge between people' connecting foreigners who want to work in Japan with reliable companies. Our mission is not just matching, but supporting 'culture,' 'goals,' and 'future' as well.
